create_chrf_metric: create a ChrF metric instance using evaluate.load for machine translation evaluation
compute_chrf_score: compute ChrF scores for predictions against reference translations with configurable character n-gram order
compute_chrfpp_score: compute ChrF++ scores by setting word_order=2 to include word n-grams alongside character n-grams
compute_chrf_lowercase: compute case-insensitive ChrF++ scores by enabling lowercase normalization on predictions and references
review_chrf_compute: review the ChrF compute method that transforms references and delegates to sacrebleu CHRF corpus_score
